panels.description: Stats for the selected range. First partial hour is dropped (h.hour >= $__from AND h.hour < $__to). Max notional and cash (Vertex/Enterprise) are kept separate.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.backend = 'max' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS "Max $ (notional)",
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.backend = 'vertex' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS "Vertex $ (cash)",
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.backend = 'enterprise' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS "Enterprise $ (cash)",
  SUM(h.n) AS requests
FROM hourly h
LEFT JOIN session_program sp ON sp.attr_key = h.attr_key
WHERE h.hour >= $__from AND h.hour < $__to
  AND h.backend IN (${backend:sqlstring})
  AND h.model IN (${model:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') IN (${program:sqlstring})

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  (h.hour / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000 AS time,
  COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') AS program,
  SUM(h.cost_usd) * 3600000.0 / $__interval_ms AS Value
FROM hourly h
LEFT JOIN session_program sp ON sp.attr_key = h.attr_key
WHERE h.hour >= $__from AND h.hour < $__to
  AND h.backend IN ('vertex', 'enterprise')
  AND h.backend IN (${backend:sqlstring})
  AND h.model IN (${model:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') IN (${program:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Top 25 sessions in the range ordered by total spend.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  h.attr_key AS attr_key,
  COALESCE(sp.title, '') AS title,
  COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') AS program,
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.backend = 'max' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS max_usd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.backend IN ('vertex','enterprise') THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS cash_usd,
  SUM(h.n) AS requests,
  MIN(h.hour) / 1000 AS first,
  MAX(h.hour) / 1000 AS last
FROM hourly h
LEFT JOIN session_program sp ON sp.attr_key = h.attr_key
WHERE h.hour >= $__from AND h.hour < $__to
  AND h.backend IN (${backend:sqlstring})
  AND h.model IN (${model:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') IN (${program:sqlstring})
GROUP BY h.attr_key
ORDER BY (max_usd + cash_usd) DESC
LIMIT 25
